Every `ha-bridge min_max` command and its help, as `--help` prints it. Each also accepts the [global flags](/commands#global-flags).

## `ha-bridge min_max`

```text
DESCRIPTION
  Min/max sensor actions

USAGE
  ha-bridge min_max <subcommand> [flags]

FLAGS
  --socket string    Path to the bridge socket (default: $HA_BRIDGE_SOCK, then $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/ha-bridge/ha-bridge.sock)
```

## `ha-bridge min_max reload`

```text
DESCRIPTION
  Reload the min_max YAML configuration

USAGE
  ha-bridge min_max reload [flags]

FLAGS
  --socket string    Path to the bridge socket (default: $HA_BRIDGE_SOCK, then $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/ha-bridge/ha-bridge.sock)
```
